summary: @servicetitan/uikit-docs preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 728 KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13, platform-specific) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it, chmods +x, and uses it to execFileSync a sibling file math_init.js that is shipped in the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line control-flow-flattened Bun bundle (starts with '// @bun @bun-cjs', hex-named identifiers, a large rotated string-array with a shuffle helper) whose behavior is not statically verifiable. The package's declared purpose is documentation (a docs/ folder of MDX), and package.json's 'files' field lists only ['docs'] — math_init.js is not in that allowlist yet is present in the published tarball. On npm install, the preinstall hook fetches an alternate runtime and runs an undeclared, obfuscated payload under it with the installer's privileges, in a scoped package whose stated purpose has no need for Bun or a native binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
